result.reason: Deleting § 12.4 achieves the preferred position of no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer. Retaining § 12.3 affirmatively confirms that position. The change is limited to the offending restriction, preserves unrelated commercial terms, and is professionally drafted. The margin comment’s fallback summary omits the express 12-month cap, but that does not affect the compliant operative language.
